product_scope: Only single_fresh_address_id_with_hint replaces the redundant is_valid call with the same expiry predicate. All cache validity primitives and caller source files remain byte-identical to185. Separate hosts fixture cherry-pick changes no hosts product code.
equivalence_proof: The hint must selectOne ID and pass existing borrowed-name pointer, cache owner/root, revision and saturation gates. A requested type other thanIpv4/Ipv6 returns before entry access.

get(id) checks slot bounds and exact generation, then returns only a present Entry. Those are exactly the first three conditions of is_valid; &self and immutable content provide no intervening mutable operation that could invalidate this result.

The existing ordered disjunction rejects mismatched record.kind, negative records, bad4/16-byte RDATA and stale entries before the substituted predicate. Reaching it establishes a positive A/AAAA entry with the requested kind.

invalid(slot,now) is exactly policy.expired(entry.expires,now) OR (kind==Cname AND outdated_cname). The establishedIpv4/Ipv6 kind makes the entire target-validity branch false, so !is_valid equals the substituted policy.expired. No referenced/committed/authority/target condition is dropped: the old non-CNAME validity path did not inspect those fields.

is_stale(now) remains strict now>expires. At exact expiry Disabled/Seconds0 reject, positiveSeconds andForever permit the fresh shortcut; after expiry every policy takes the existing fallback because is_stale is true. The original i128 arithmetic forSeconds is called unchanged, preserving negative and extreme signed times.

The selector still has no LRU promotion, pruning, cache mutation, Arc detachment or allocation. single_fresh_address_with_hint retains its original unlink/link promotion after successful selection; rejected entries remain for the original lookup and expiry-removal boundary.

callers_and_compatibility.local_owner: LocalAnswerer calls the read-only selector before the existing unclaimed-owner check; hosts/leases/configured records retain priority.
callers_and_compatibility.cache_answer: Mutable address-hit helper uses the same selector then performs original single-slot promotion.
callers_and_compatibility.general_validity: is_valid, invalid, outdated_cname and all generic/CNAME/negative/RRset lookup paths remain unchanged. No generic validity API is weakened.
callers_and_compatibility.publication_and_snapshots: ID generations, hint revision invalidation, snapshot roots and COW behavior are unchanged. Lease-expiry-bound and owner-clock prototypes are not combined into this candidate.

coverage.matrix: 5 stale policies x2 address types x5 signed expiries x3 boundary times =150 assertions of eligibility, plus read-only state and retained-entry checks. MIN+1/MAX-1 expiries make +/-1 operations representable.
coverage.existing_regressions: Fresh hint promotion/fallback, mismatched query/kind, changed members, cache replacement/movement, revision saturation, multi-record rotation/COW. Existing daemon A/AAAA UDP/TCP precedence tests remain unchanged.
coverage.limits: No new product wire differential or Linux qualification is claimed. The one-line proof does not rely on new benchmark or timing evidence.
